# Runtime notices

These notices are copied from the portable LLVM-MinGW
`20261006-ucrt-x86_64` distribution used to build the Windows release:

- `LLVM.txt`: the distribution's top-level `LICENSE.TXT`, including LLVM exceptions.
- `COPYING*`: notices from `x86_64-w64-mingw32/share/mingw32` for MinGW-w64 and winpthreads.

The project source remains MIT licensed. These files accompany binaries that
embed the respective runtimes; inclusion does not imply every component is linked
into every platform's binary. No compiler or Python interpreter is redistributed.
